newsitem.title: JAPAN: China's CITIC launches three tranches of samurais.
newsitem.headline: China's CITIC launches three tranches of samurais.

text.p: Beijing-based China International Trust and Investment Corp (CITIC) launched on Tuesday three tranches of samurai bonds worth a total of 40 billion yen, lead managers Nikko Securities and Nomura Securities said.
One set of five-year samurai bonds worth 20 billion yen, with a coupon of 2.75 percent, is priced at par and due on September 19, 2001, lead manager Nomura said.
Another tranche of bonds worth 10 billion yen carries a coupon of 3.70 percent. The bonds are priced at par and will mature on March 18, 2005, said Nikko, which is the lead manager for this issue.
The remaining set of 20-year samurai bonds worth 10 billion yen, carrying a coupon of 4.95 percent, matures on September 19, 2016. These bonds are also priced at par, Nikko said.
